'''Cluck Norris''' is a character who is mentioned in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]'' and ''[[Grand Theft Auto: Chinatown Wars]]'', and who appears in ''[[Grand Theft Auto IV]]''. 

==History==
===Background===
Cluck is the mascot of the [[Cluckin' Bell (HD Universe)|Cluckin' Bell]] restaurant franchise. He is [[United States of America|African-American]] and wears a yellow chicken helmet.

===Events of ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas''===
In ''GTA San Andreas'', the Cluckin' Bell employees wear a Cluck Norris outfit and one of the participants the player have to beat in the [[Beat the Cock!|triathlon]] also wears a Cluck Norris outfit.

===Events of ''Grand Theft Auto IV''===
In ''GTA IV'', Cluck Norris is displayed as a toy inside a glass box in all Cluckin' Bell restaurants.

===Events of ''Grand Theft Auto: Chinatown Wars''===
In ''GTA Chinatown Wars'', Cluck Norris appears on a Cluckin' Bell billboard and in an advertisement on the side of a [[Yankee|truck]].

==Trivia==
*"Cluck Norris" is an obvious play on the name of the late famous American martial artist and film producer {{WP|Chuck Norris}}.
*A free Cluck Norris action figure apparently comes with every "clucky meal", similar to how Cluckin' Bell included Bobby Broiler (chicken) action figures with every kids meal in ''GTA San Andreas'' (seen on [http://cluckinbellhappychicken.com Cluckin' Bell's website]).
